'''Nak'har''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] criminal who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In about [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian|Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Gomalo]] was released from [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and put together a team of his former contacts, which included Nak'har, to steal a sculpture that contained the coordinates of the location of the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ji-Ad Sarain]]. Nak'har, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thook Lafrell]] and some of Gomalo's other thugs stole the sculpture and various other pieces of artwork from a display in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], and they took the works of art to a room in the [[Starlight Lounge]], a hotel that Gomalo was using as his base of operations. The undercover [[Cularin Office of Public Safety]] agent [[Ezra Du'Re]] was dispatched to recover the missing items, and Nak'har and Lafrell captured her and escorted her to their hotel room, to use her as insurance while they completed their job for Gomalo. However, a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] investigated Du'Re's disappearance and tracked her to the Starlight Lounge, where they confronted Nak'har and Gomalo's other thugs.
